reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with how compliant findings are handled.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 3's 'Restrictions on Use' (including the service-bureau limit in p0039) constrains only the scope of the licence in the Vendor's Work, not the businesses Sparkling may operate or the products it may buy or build, so it is not a non-compete or field-of-use covenant within the meaning of this rule.
p0133 is a mutual employee non-solicitation, correctly excluded here and routed to the non-solicitation rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains; redline output is identical to the original paragraphs, as expected for a compliant finding.
